anti_patterns.title: Unbounded Markdown Streaming
anti_patterns.why_failed: Passing raw stream chunks directly to Markdown render triggers NoneType region calculation exceptions.
anti_patterns.replacement: Buffer incoming tokens with a 50ms coalesce debounce before updating widget.

anti_patterns.title: Direct DB Calls in Event Loop
anti_patterns.why_failed: Synchronous SQLite calls on the main thread block UI event dispatching and cause UI freezing.
anti_patterns.replacement: Execute all disk queries inside an async threadpool or use a dedicated database worker.

anti_patterns.title: Shell String Interpolation & Missing Subprocess Sanitization
anti_patterns.why_failed: Arbitrary string formatting (shell=True) invites command injection, and unsanitized child processes inherit host API keys and tokens.
anti_patterns.replacement: Pass argument vectors List[str] to asyncio.create_subprocess_exec and filter env through sanitize_subprocess_env().

anti_patterns.title: Modal Push Without Deduplication
anti_patterns.why_failed: Rapid hardware key repeats push identical modal screens concurrently, corrupting Textual screen stack.
anti_patterns.replacement: Check 'if not any(isinstance(s, DialogClass) for s in self.app._screen_stack)' before push_screen().

anti_patterns.title: Textual Timer Cancellation (.cancel() vs .stop())
anti_patterns.why_failed: Textual timers are not asyncio tasks; calling timer.cancel() raises AttributeError or crashes the worker.
anti_patterns.replacement: Always call timer.stop() on Textual Timer instances.

anti_patterns.title: Editable Installs in CI Packaging Tests
anti_patterns.why_failed: pip install -e . hides missing package assets, uncommitted manifests, and broken entry points.
anti_patterns.replacement: Build distribution wheel (python -m build --wheel) and test against isolated installed wheel.

anti_patterns.title: Static Sleeps in Asynchronous UI Tests
anti_patterns.why_failed: Static sleeps fail under shared virtualized CI loads due to hypervisor CPU scheduling jitter.
anti_patterns.replacement: Use an active settle loop that awaits in-flight debounce tasks and checks DOM readiness.

anti_patterns.title: PyPI OIDC Publishing via workflow_call
anti_patterns.why_failed: PyPI Trusted Publisher rejects tokens from reusable workflows because job_workflow_ref mismatches.
anti_patterns.replacement: Trigger publishing directly from top-level release: [published] or workflow_dispatch events.

anti_patterns.title: Raw Scanner Output in LLM Prompts
anti_patterns.why_failed: Untrusted tool outputs can contain prompt injection attacks that hijack tutor reasoning.
anti_patterns.replacement: Wrap scan output in <untrusted_scan_output> tags and escape closing tag breakouts.

anti_patterns.title: Hardcoded Terminal Separator Multiplication
anti_patterns.why_failed: Multiplying character strings ('=' * 80) causes catastrophic line wrapping when terminal panes are resized.
anti_patterns.replacement: Yield dynamic rich.rule.Rule instances inside custom Markdown elements.
